study_name.notes: No canonical study identifier in the form EinsteinA_YYYY provided.

subject_id.notes: This is a meta-analysis of multiple cohorts; individual subject IDs not provided in the paper.

sample_id.notes: Individual sample IDs not reported; data are from 9,428 aggregated metagenomes.

curator.notes: Curator names not explicitly stated in the paper.

subcohort.notes: Meta-analysis of 46 datasets; no single subcohort identifier.

target_condition.evidence_quote: human microbiome plays a role in health, but its full diversity remains uncharacterized
target_condition.notes: Primary focus is characterizing unexplored human microbiome diversity across body sites, ages, countries, and lifestyles.

control.notes: This is a metagenomic assembly study without explicit case-control design; samples are from various cohorts but not classified as cases or controls.

country.evidence_quote: spanning body sites, ages, countries, and lifestyles
country.notes: Samples span 31 countries including USA, China, Israel, Sweden, Denmark, Madagascar, Ethiopia, Fiji, Tanzania, Mongolia, Peru.

body_site.evidence_quote: 5 major body sites: 7,783 samples from the gut (stool samples), 783 from the oral cavity, 503 from the skin, 88 from the vagina, 9 from maternal milk
body_site.section: STAR Methods — Meta-analyzed publicly available metagenomic datasets
body_site.notes: Multiple body sites sampled; primarily feces and oral cavity.

body_site_details.evidence_quote: gut (stool samples), oral cavity, skin (including 93 samples from anterior nares), vagina, maternal milk
body_site_details.section: STAR Methods — Meta-analyzed publicly available metagenomic datasets

days_from_first_collection.notes: Not applicable; this is a cross-sectional meta-analysis of multiple studies.

lifestyle.evidence_quote: traditional Fijian population, hunter-gatherer Hadza population, traditional agro-pastoral Mongolian population, Peruvian rural community

location.value: Madagascar, Ethiopia, Fiji, Tanzania, Mongolia, Peru

probing_pocket_depth.notes: Not a periodontal study; probing pocket depth measurements not reported.

westernized.evidence_quote: total of 592 non-Westernized compared with 8,836 Westernized samples

antibiotics_exclusion_period.notes: Antibiotic exclusion criteria not reported in the paper.

sequencing_platform.section: STAR Methods — DNA extraction and sequencing

age.notes: Age range reported for Madagascar cohort as <74 years; specific individual ages not reported.

family.notes: Not systematically reported; some mother-infant pairs mentioned in validation but not indexed as family units.

family_role.evidence_quote: stool and breast milk samples from mother-infant pairs

family_role.notes: Mother-infant pairs mentioned in validation studies but not systematically sampled in the main cohorts.

sex.section: STAR Methods — Enrollment of participants from non-Westernized populations

zigosity.notes: Twin zygosity not mentioned in paper; paper focuses on microbiome genomes from metagenomes, not twin studies.

age_min.section: STAR Methods — Meta-analyzed publicly available metagenomic datasets
age_min.notes: Minimum age in study population; newborns represent youngest age category.

age_max.section: STAR Methods — Enrollment of participants from non-Westernized populations
age_max.notes: Maximum age reported for Madagascar cohort enrollment.

age_years.notes: Study reports age groups rather than individual participant ages. Age categories: newborns <1 year, children 1-12 years, school-age 12-19 years, adults ≥19 years.

antibiotics_current_use.notes: Paper does not report current antibiotic use for participants.

bmi.notes: BMI data not provided in the paper.

dietary_restriction.notes: No specific dietary restrictions reported for participants, though dietary differences between Westernized and non-Westernized populations are discussed broadly.

disease.evidence_quote: 112 healthy volunteers (54 females and 58 males, Table S1)
disease.section: STAR Methods — Enrollment of participants from non-Westernized populations
disease.notes: Madagascar cohort described as healthy volunteers. Ethiopia cohort also appears healthy based on context. No disease conditions reported as inclusion criterion.

disease_details.notes: No specific disease details provided; study focuses on healthy populations.

disease_response_orr.notes: Paper is observational microbiome study; no treatment response data provided.

disease_response_pfs.notes: No progression-free survival data; not a clinical trial paper.

disease_response_recist.notes: RECIST criteria not applicable; observational microbiome study without cancer treatment.

feces_phenotype.notes: No stool phenotype or clinical measurements recorded; only microbiome composition analyzed.

fmt_id.notes: Study is not a fecal microbiota transplantation study; no FMT participants.

fmt_role.notes: No FMT study design; observational metagenomics research.

hla.notes: HLA typing not performed or reported.

neonatal_birth_weight.notes: Birth weight data not available for study cohorts.

neonatal_delivery_procedure.notes: Delivery method (cesarean vs vaginal) not reported in paper.

neonatal_feeding_method.notes: Infant feeding methods (breast vs formula) not documented in provided metadata.

neonatal_gestational_age.notes: Gestational age at birth not reported for study participants.

neonatal_preterm_birth.notes: Preterm vs term birth status not reported in paper.

obgyn_lactating.notes: Lactation status not reported; study includes 9 maternal milk samples but no metadata on lactating status.

obgyn_menopause.notes: Menopausal status not reported for female participants.

obgyn_pregnancy.notes: Current pregnancy status not documented; maternal milk samples included but no pregnancy information provided.

smoker.notes: Smoking status or history not reported for participants.

treatment.notes: No therapeutic treatments or medications documented for study cohorts.

tumor_staging_ajcc.notes: No cancer patients; AJCC staging not applicable.

tumor_staging_tnm.notes: No TNM staging; observational microbiome study without cancer cohorts.

biomarker_name.notes: This paper is a metagenomic genomics study focused on microbial genome reconstruction and species-level genome bins (SGBs), not on biomarkers for clinical outcomes or disease states.

biomarker_unit.notes: Not applicable; paper does not report clinical biomarker units.

biomarker_value.notes: Not applicable; paper does not report clinical biomarker values.

disease_response_os.notes: This is a microbiome genomics study, not a clinical trial or disease outcome study; overall survival is not measured.

disease_response_os_unit.notes: Not applicable; no overall survival data reported.

ecog_performance_status.notes: ECOG performance status is a clinical assessment tool not reported in this microbiome genomics study.

tumor_size_measurement.notes: This is a microbiome study, not an oncology study; tumor measurements are not applicable.

tumor_size_residual_measurement.notes: Not applicable; no tumor-related measurements in this microbiome study.

control field cannot be filled; this is not a case-control study but a discovery/characterization study of microbiome diversity.

This paper is a metagenomics study focused on microbiome diversity reconstruction, not a clinical or patient-level phenotypic study. Most participant-level clinical and demographic fields are not reported.
The study includes healthy volunteers from Madagascar and Ethiopia; Madagascar cohort explicitly described as 'healthy volunteers.'
Age information is reported by category (newborns <1 year, children 1-12 years, school-age 12-19 years, adults ≥19 years) rather than individual ages.
The paper does not contain medical history, treatment data, disease phenotypes, or other detailed participant clinical metadata typical of clinical microbiome studies.

Schema requests clinical/oncology-related fields (ECOG status, tumor size, overall survival) that are not applicable to this microbiome genomics study. Only feces_phenotype_value and uncurated_metadata were populated with relevant study information.
biomarker_name, biomarker_unit, biomarker_value are not reported because the paper does not measure clinical biomarkers; it catalogs microbial genomic diversity.
